Viceroy '''Eldin Sunstrider''' is an elite blood elf located in [[Felstrider Retreat]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. A distant cousin to Prince [[Kael'thas Sunstrider]], Eldin leads a group of blood elves that did not follow their prince to Northrend, and instead fortified the mountain stronghold of Felstrider Retreat.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|9|Felstrider Retreat (quest)|Felstrider Retreat}}</ref> When the [[Silvermoon Remnant]] began to resettle the Highlands, Eldin tasked [[Veloren Brightstar]] with spying on the refugees in [[Brinthilien]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|5|A Letter from the Royalty}}</ref>

[[Astalor Sunsworn]] wants Eldin assassinated in order to remove a potential rival to the throne of Quel'Thalas.
